technical_check:
PYTHONPATH=src python3 - <<'PY'
import os, threading
import requests.utils as utils
original = os.environ.pop('no_proxy', None)
t1_entered = threading.Event(); t2_entered = threading.Event(); t1_done = threading.Event()
def controlled(_host):
    if threading.current_thread().name == 't1':
        t1_entered.set(); assert t2_entered.wait(2)
    else:
        t2_entered.set(); assert t1_done.wait(2)
    return False
old = utils.proxy_bypass; utils.proxy_bypass = controlled
errors = []
def call(value):
    try: utils.should_bypass_proxies('https://example.com', value)
    except BaseException as exc: errors.append(exc)
t1 = threading.Thread(target=call, args=('one.invalid',), name='t1')
t2 = threading.Thread(target=call, args=('two.invalid',), name='t2')
try:
    t1.start(); assert t1_entered.wait(2); t2.start(); assert t2_entered.wait(2)
    t1.join(2); t1_done.set(); t2.join(2)
    assert not errors and 'no_proxy' not in os.environ, (errors, os.environ.get('no_proxy'))
finally:
    utils.proxy_bypass = old
    if original is None: os.environ.pop('no_proxy', None)
    else: os.environ['no_proxy'] = original
PY
